title: Marcel Proust's birth chart
metaDescription: Marcel Proust's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 17.7° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Uranus. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 17.7° Cancer — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Mars, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 16.5° Cancer, Venus was at 3.1° Virgo, Mars was at 11.2° Libra. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that grows by reliability; effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Mars at right angles from Jupiter, 0.6° off exact. A square is friction that produces motion — the aspect the tradition credits with building capability precisely by refusing to be comfortable. Behind it, the Sun conjunction Mercury at 1.2°, and the Sun sextile Pluto at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Jupiter opposes Saturn while both square Mars. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. Venus in Virgo at 3.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Libra at 11.2° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Cancer at 10.6° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Capricorn at 5.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 water, 3 earth, 1 air, 1 fire by element and 7 cardinal, 1 mutable, 1 fixed by mode. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. Saturn was retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.2° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
